login.title: Ewe chon fiti ewe chanel
login.portalName: Ewe Poratal ren chon chiechi ngeni ewe chanel
login.welcome: Kapong ngenikemi sefan! Sipwe fiti pwe kopwe manaweni om kewe lead.
login.heroTitle: Kopwe anapano om business ren imw ren iteiten lead ka uwei .
login.heroIntro: Ew portal ren omw kopwe makketiw iten chon kamo ren chon kau imw, kopwe tumunu ewe credit ren omw kewe chon emwen me tapweno mwirir tori ar repwe booking.

register.title: Register ekkewe lead non ekkoch seken .
register.text: Kopwe tinato noumw we chon kamo me ewe prokram ra mochen.

protect.title: Kopwe tumunuoch .
protect.text: Omw ewe lead epwe nomw reomw ren ewe fansoun tumun, ina minne ese wor emon epwe tongeni claim ewe chok chon kamo.

track.title: Track meinisin ekkewe kinikin .
track.text: Nengeni nonomun emon me emon lead me unusen uruon, seni ewe aewin churi ngeni ewe booking.

handover.title: Kredit atun ka puk
handover.text: Nupwen emon chon kamo a book, ewe lead a kawor ngeni ewe chon kau imw ren en ka makketiw pwe en ewe chon fiti ewe source.

login.secure: Kopwe tumunuoch - porausen noum kewe chon kamo repwe chok monomon
login.builderLink: Sain ngeni ewe portal ren chon kau imw .
